r.name: Rail Trail: Bearley > Claverdon
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 4.75-mile walk to discover ancient villages, churches and leafy woodland amid some truly glorious Warwickshire countryside. Duration: 2.5 hours Distance: 4.75 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Claverdon > Hatton
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 3-mile short trail through gently rolling farmland and past pockets of woodland to the Grand Union Canal and its “stairway to heaven” flight of locks at Hatton. Duration: 1.5 hours Distance: 3 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Hatton > Lapworth
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 5.5-mile easy amble following the towpath of the Grand Union Canal through some of Warwickshire’s finest countryside. Duration: 2.5 hours Distance: 5.5 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Lapworth Circular
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 3.75-mile lovely rural and waterside ramble, taking in Tudor Mansions, no less than three pubs and a flight of locks around the village of Lapworth. Duration: 2 hours Distance: 3.75 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Dorridge > Lapworth
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 5.5-mile gentle wander through wealthy suburbia, along country lanes and onto the peace and tranquillity of the Grand Union Canal towpath to Lapworth. Duration: 2.5 hours Distance: 4.5 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Warwick Parkway Circular via Hatton
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 5.1-mile strike out into glorious rolling countryside en route to Hatton’s famous flight of 21 locks on the Grand Union Canal. Duration: 2.5 hours Distance: 5.1 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Warwick Circular
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 7.8-mile walk exploring Warwickshire’s historic county town and its world famous Castle as you wander along the banks of the River Avon. Duration: 4 hours Distance: 7.8 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Royal Leamington Spa Circular via Offchurch
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 7.2-mile walk branching out from this fashionable spa town to follow the Grand Union Canal to the village of Offchurch and back via Newbold Comyn. Duration: 4 hours Distance: 7.2 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Kenilworth Circular
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 7.4-mile lovely countryside wander with the opportunity to meet Alpacas, spot WW2 relics and take a detour into historic Kenilworth and it’s castle. Duration: 3.5 hours Distance: 7.4 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Coventry's Historic Centre
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 3-mile walk allowing you to get intimate with vibrant Coventry… This trail will get you up close and personal with this unsung city of history, art and culture. Duration: 1.5 hours Distance: 3 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Canley > Coventry
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 2.5-mile easy scenic wander through the surprisingly green space surrounding Canley and Earlsdon on the edge of Coventry. Duration: 1.5 hours Distance: 2.5 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Tile Hill Circular
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 3.8-mile woodland ramble through Coventry’s suburbia exploring the remnants of the Forest of Ardern and Tile Hill’s industrial heritage. Duration: 2 hours Distance: 3.8 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Berkswell Circular
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 2.7-mile rural ramble to the historic village of Berkswell with its 16th and 17th-century houses and world-famous Berkswell Cheese! Duration: 1.5 hours Distance: 2.7 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Hampton-in-Arden Circular
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 3.6-mile easy amble from the ancient village of Hampton-in-Arden across the river Blythe to Marsh Lane Nature Reserve and back. Duration: 1.5 hours Distance: 3.6 miles

r.name: Rail Trail: Birmingham International > Marston Green
r.operator: Heart of England Community Rail Partnership
r.description: A 4-mile walk discovering wildflower meadows, oak woodland and parkland along Low Brook on an easy route to Marston Green. Plane spotting optional! Duration: 1.5 hours Distance: 4 miles

r.name: Baddesley Clinton Canal Walk, Baddesley Clinton
r.operator: National Trust
r.description: Optional short loop 4.8km. Uneven sections with some steps, kissing gates and stiles. Field paths may be marshy following wet weather. Take care on roads. Livestock (and their droppings) are present, along with some water hazards (ponds and ditches).

r.name: Baddesley Clinton Estate Walk, Baddesley Clinton
r.operator: National Trust
r.description: There are some uneven sections with kissing gates and stiles. Field paths can be marshy and muddy following wet weather. Livestock (and their droppings) are present, along with some water hazards (ponds and ditches).

r.name: Baddesley Clinton to Packwood Walk, Baddesley Clinton
r.operator: National Trust
r.description: Uneven sections with some steps, kissing gates and stiles. Field paths may be marshy following wet weather. Take care on roads. Livestock (and their droppings) are present, along with some water hazards (ponds and ditches).

r.name: Heart of England Way Countryside Walk, Baddesley Clinton
r.operator: National Trust
r.description: Uneven sections with some steps, kissing gates and stiles. Field paths will be marshy following wet weather. Take care on roads. Livestock (and their droppings) are present, along with some water hazards (ponds and ditches).
